events.verdict: Daniels (ATL) makes contact with the ball after it exits the imaginary cylinder above the rim.
McCain (PHI) moves alongside Alexander-Walker's (ATL) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Okongwu (ATL) absorbs the contact from Grimes (PHI) as he contests the shot attempt.
Risacher (ATL) briefly grasps Maxey's (PHI) arm as the two come together in pursuit of the rebound.
McCain (PHI) does not re-route Alexander-Walker (ATL) into Grimes (PHI) as he moves to set the pick.  Alexander-Walker then delivers contact with his upper body as he sets the pick on Grimes.
McCain (PHI) initiates more than marginal contact with Johnson's (ATL) left arm as he secures the rebound.
Alexander-Walker (ATL) grazes Grimes' (PHI) arm prior to the start of his upward shooting motion.
George (PHI) commits a take foul on Johnson (ATL).
Embiid (PHI) is firming up over his right leg in Alexander-Walker's (ATL) path prior to contact.
Embiid (PHI) commits a take foul on Daniels (ATL).
Embiid (PHI) establishes himself in Johnson's (ATL) path prior to the contact.
George (PHI) and Risacher (ATL) briefly engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.
Grimes (PHI) commits a take foul on Johnson (ATL).
Johnson (ATL) is drawn into the air towards Barlow (PHI) and initiates body contact as he defends the shot attempt.
George (PHI) and Alexander-Walker (ATL) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and the contact is marginal.
Embiid (PHI) legally contests Daniels' (ATL) driving shot attempt.  Coach Nurse's (PHI) request for a timeout is not recognized by the officiating crew.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Replay review of the out of bounds called on Daniels (ATL) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. McCain (PHI) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds, and possession is correctly awarded to the Hawks.
Okongwu (ATL) releases away from Barlow (PHI) following the expiration of the pick.
Risacher (ATL) brings his arm towards Maxey (PHI) on the perimeter and the contact is marginal.
Risacher (ATL) moves alongside Maxey's (PHI) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Barlow (PHI) cleanly blocks Johnson's (ATL) shot attempt before the ball touches the backboard.
Risacher (ATL) moves laterally into Maxey's (PHI) path and initiates body contact that affects Maxey's SQBR.
Maxey (PHI) initiates foot to foot contact with Alexander-Walker (ATL) that affects his SQBR.
Barlow (PHI) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Johnson's (ATL) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Daniels (ATL) commits a take foul on Maxey (PHI).

Barlow (PHI) jumps A to B into Johnson (ATL) and initiates contact that affects his shot attempt. Coach Nurse (PHI) then called for and was granted a timeout, and due to a miscommunication among the officials, a coach's challenge review of the foul was conducted erroneously.  Upon clarification, the game clock was set to 00.3, and the coach's challenge not charged.
McCain (PHI) inbounds the ball within five seconds.
Daniels (ATL) and Bona (PHI) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and the contact is marginal.
Bona (PHI) grazes Alexander-Walker's (ATL) left arm as he passes the ball.
Bona (PHI) moves towards Alexander-Walker's (ATL) path and the contact on the perimeter is marginal.
Bona (PHI) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Hawks.
McCain (PHI) delivers contact with his side as he sets the pick on Daniels (ATL).
Okongwu (ATL) maintains verticality as he defends Maxey's (PHI) shot attempt.
Alexander-Walker (ATL) trips over Maxey (PHI) as he turns to run down the court.
McCain (PHI) commits a take foul on Krejci (ATL).
Johnson (ATL) leaves his feet to pass and he does not release the ball prior to when his feet return to the ground.
